verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI's GitHub integration lets you mention @gemini-cli in issues for 'task delegation', and the CLI documents codebase editing and PR-related automation. However, nothing explicitly shows it taking a tracked issue through code changes to an opened pull request. Community reports of unreliable agentic editing lower confidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that an issue can be turned into a generated and opened PR, an end-to-end workflow description (branch, commit, PR creation), hands-on corroboration of issue-to-PR runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end

citations.quote: Mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for help with debugging, explanations, or task delegation
Automate operational tasks like querying pull requests or handling complex rebases
